noscript: Trillion Euro works best with JavaScript on — the live counters, map and voting need it. Everything you read here is still true without it.
foot.tag: A free global movement: make €1 trillion of value and put it back into the world — decided by the people who join.
foot.legal.text: Trillion Euro is a free community movement. The €1 trillion figure is a long-term aspiration — it is not money held, raised, pledged or guaranteed, and nothing on this site asks for or accepts payment. Joining is free. Voting on priorities expresses community preferences and creates no financial commitment. Nothing here is an offer of investment, a donation appeal, or financial advice. Every number on this site comes from real registrations; where there are none yet, it says so. Flag artwork: Twemoji, © Twitter, Inc. and other contributors, CC-BY 4.0. Map data: Natural Earth (public domain).
